question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

Incapable of being read
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1' **i.e. **'illegible'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "illegible"** means difficult or impossible to read due to poor handwriting, faintness, or other factors that make the text unclear or indiscernible.(अस्पष्ट)
 
• **Incapable of being read** (पठनीय न होने योग्य)
 
• So, the **correct word** that can **substitute** the given group of words is** 'illegible'.**

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Illegible'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of all other given words.
 
 
• **Comprehensive:** Comprehensive refers to something that is thorough, extensive, or inclusive, covering a wide range or including all aspects or details of a particular subject.(व्यापक)
 
• **Decipherable: **Decipherable means capable of being understood or interpreted, typically referring to the ability to decode or make sense of something that is difficult to comprehend.(समझने योग्य)
 
• **Corrupt:** Corrupt means morally or ethically dishonest, or having been altered or damaged in a way that affects its integrity or reliability.(भ्रष्ट)
